title: Juicy Peppery Turkey Stir-fry
description: A kid-friendly Portuguese dish featuring turkey, slow-cooked to perfection with a touch of spicy peppery flavor and dairy-free options for a deliciously healthy meal.
instructions: Season the turkey with coarse ground black pepper and pinch of salt. Place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Sauté onions until translucent, then add garlic and red bell peppers for another minute or two.
Transfer vegetables to an oven-safe dish and top the turkey with them. Drizzle with additional olive oil and sprinkle chili flakes if using.
Bake in preheated oven for 25-30 minutes until the turkey is cooked through. Stir vegetables occasionally while baking.
In a separate pan, heat some more olive oil over medium-high heat. Add diced tomatoes to it and cook until they start softening, about 1 minute.
Garnish with fresh parsley if available. Serve hot as an accompaniment for the turkey dish.
